target.description: Id of the ONE target {group} to deploy into; {node} ids are rejected. The source is always the configured predecessor of this {group} (deploy.from)

tag.description: The tag of the release on the source, e.g. REL-2026-10-07; every diagram group of the owner that carries it is deployed; no wildcards

owner.description: The owner (user or user group) of the release; default: inventory.owner of the target {group}

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview of the first call; deploys (or writes the packages)
